description: Use this when the user asks about a letter they created here: status (draft, paid, in_production, printed, posted, cancelled, returned), tracking number for registered mail, and price. Look up by letter_id or reference (PM-XXXXXX). Changes nothing. Needs the user's account.

letter_id.description: letter_id from create_letter, compose_letter or list_letters, e.g. ltr_8f3k2m9q4x7v1c6b0n5p. Pass letter_id or reference.

reference.description: The letter's reference as shown to the user, format PM-XXXXXX, e.g. PM-7K3QH9. Pass letter_id or reference.

name: get_letter
title: Get letter
